bulk.title: Export every patient's file
bulk.lead: One ZIP with a folder per patient: a PDF summary, every prescription, report, request, referral, certificate and invoice as PDF, the images and files as uploaded, and JSON data — with an Excel index of the patients and their folders.
bulk.how: The export is built in the background while you keep working; a large clinic can take a few minutes. The file stays 24 hours, then is removed.
bulk.confirm: Export every patient's file? The export is recorded in the clinic's log and every file's access log. Keep the file somewhere safe.
bulk.started: The export has started. Its progress shows here.
bulk.expires: Removed automatically 24 hours after it was made.
bulk.privacy: Each file holds only what you may see.
bulk.skipped_row: This file could not be included
bulk.readme:
Patient files — {n} patients — exported on {date}

index.xlsx / index.csv   every patient and their folder
patients/                one folder per patient with:
   00-summary.pdf        the file summary
   papers/               prescriptions, reports, requests, referrals, certificates, invoices (PDF)
   files/                images and files as uploaded
   data.json             the data in a portable form

err.EXPORT_RUNNING: An export is already running. Wait until it finishes.
